key.name: blank-after
key.summary: Blank, and so lock, after this idle time
key.description: Seconds of idle time before the screens fade to black, turn off and the session locks. 0 means never, and is set only by a person's choice.

key.name: suspend-after-battery
key.description: Seconds of idle time before the machine suspends while it runs on battery. 0 means never.

key.name: suspend-after-ac
key.description: Seconds of idle time before the machine suspends while it runs on mains power. 0 means never.

key.name: migrated
key.summary: The one-time migration from cosmic-idle has run
key.description: Set by athanor-idle after it copies com.system76.CosmicIdle (SD16). Nothing is copied at start once it is true.
